items.text: A famous Indian singer named Sidhu Moose Wala was shot dead in the northern Indian state of Punjab in broad daylight. The singer died while going to the hospital. The event happened only one day after police reduced his security cover . Authorities said that they suspected inter-gang violence; however, Moose Wala’s family demanded an apology for the suggestion without an investigation. Moose Wala was traveling with two other people who were injured in the attack. According to police, the singer’s security was reduced to two commandos from four, and they weren’t traveling with him when he was attacked. Moose Walla was one of Punjab’s biggest pop stars; however, he was also a controversial person. Critics often commented on his promoting of violence and gun culture. The singer made his political debut in 2021 when he joined the main opposition party in India. Difficult words: security cover (a service to provide protection), commando (a soldier who has training on dangerous or difficult attacks), debut (the first appearance or performance). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A popular Indian singer named Sidhu Moose Wala was killed when he was traveling in the state of Punjab. Moose Walla was traveling with two other men, when suddenly several cars came close to theirs, and someone started to shoot. Moose Walla died on the way to the hospital, and the two other men were hurt. Police said that a gang killed the singer, but Moose Walla’s family didn’t agree. They said that it was important to investigate the situation first. The incident happened only one day after police reduced the singer’s security. The singer was famous all over India, and his death shocked his fans. In 2021, he joined politics when he became a member of the main opposition party . Difficult words: gang (a group of criminals), reduce (to make something smaller or less), opposition party (a group of people who have different ideas from the government). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Sidhu Moose Walla is an Indian singer. He is very popular. He is 28 years old. Someone kills the singer last week. Moose Walla is traveling with two other men in a car. Several cars get close to them. Someone starts to shoot. Moose Walla dies. The other two men are hurt. Police protect the singer before this event. Sadly, it changes one day before he dies. Police say that a gang kills him. Moose Walla’s family don’t agree. Moose Walla is popular in all of India. He writes beautiful songs. Some people say that he likes violence and guns. He joins politics in 2021. Difficult words: protect (to keep safe), gang (a group of criminals), violence (physical behaviors against other people). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A man disguised himself as an elderly woman in a wheelchair; then he threw cake at the Mona Lisa, Leonardo da Vinci’s famous painting at the Louvre in Paris, France. The man was wearing a wig and lipstick, and visitors also saw him throwing roses in the gallery. He ran up to the painting, and he started punching it before he smeared cake all over it. In the 1950s, the Renaissance painting had protective glass installed to protect it after an acid attack, so it wasn’t damaged. People described the incident as jaw-dropping , and the crowd panicked a little. The man urged people to think of the Earth while the security led him away. Police detained him and sent him to a police psychiatric unit. An investigation started into the damage of cultural artifacts . Difficult words: disguise (to change your appearance to hide your identity), jaw-dropping (surprising or shocking), artifact (an object from the past). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A man dressed as an elderly woman, and he came to the Louvre in Paris, France, on a wheelchair . People saw him throwing roses, and then, he came to the room with Leonardo da Vinci’s famous painting of Mona Lisa. The man stood up, and he started to punch the painting. Luckily, the painting was protected by special glass. The man then threw cake on the painting, which shocked everyone around him. Security took only a minute to lead the man away. The man shouted that people didn’t care about our planet enough. In the 1950s, someone damaged the painting with acid . Since that time, people put glass over it to protect it. Difficult words: wheelchair (a chair with wheels which people use it they can’t walk), punch (to hit with the hand), acid (a special mixture which can destroy things). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

An old woman comes to the Louvre in Paris, France. She sits on a wheelchair . She throws flowers around her. She come to the room with the Mona Lisa. The Mona Lisa is a famous painting by Leonardo da Vinci. The woman stands up. She hits the painting. Luckily, glass is in front of the painting. The woman hits the glass. Then she throws cake at it. The room is full of shocked people. The security come. They see that the person is not an old woman. He is a man. He shouts that people don’t care about our planet. In the past, people attack the Mona Lisa. The special glass keeps it safe since the 1950s. Difficult words: wheelchair (a chair for people who cannot walk easily), shock (an emotion you feel from a lot of surprise), security (a person who keeps a place safe). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

China’s pig breeders use genetics to ensure that the world’s biggest pork consumer is self-sufficient and pork meat is lower cost. Around a hundred pig farms enrolled in a state program that aims to develop pigs that grow faster, need less food, and make bigger litters . A farm in Mongolia participated in the program, too, and some farmers said that breeding from foreign hogs wasn’t always right for China. Unlike the Europeans, Chinese people may not like the other pigs because of different food cultures and environments. To raise a pig in China costs about two and a half times as much as in the US. Pigs are costly because of imported feed and high levels of disease. Therefore, China has a big demand for genetic improvements; however, Chinese farmers have very little experience on genetics, nor on data collection on pigs, including litter size, loin depth, and daily weight gain. Difficult words: litter (a number of young animals born to an animal at one time), hog (a pig), loin (meat from the back of an animal near the tail). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

To raise a pig costs about two and a half times more in China than in the US. The reasons are that feed is expensive, and pigs have many diseases. Chinese pig breeders want to change the situation, and they think that genetics can help them. Around a hundred pig farms are in a special program where farmers try to breed new pigs. These pigs will grow faster, eat less, and more piglets will be born to one sow . Some experts say that the program will be difficult because Chinese pig breeders have little experience. They don’t know how to get the information, which is necessary for the program. Also, Chinese people may not like the meat because they have different tastes than Europeans. Difficult words: breeder (a person who raises animals to make babies), genetics (the study to change information inside a plant or animal to make a different plant or animal), sow (a female pig). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

To produce pigs in China is very expensive. It costs about two and a half times more than in the US. Why is producing pigs so expensive? China buys feed for pigs from other countries. It costs a lot of money. Also, many diseases are on Chinese pig farms. Chinese farmers think that genetics can help them. They will produce bigger pigs. They will eat less. One female pig will have more babies. One hundred pig farms are in a special program. The program is not easy. Chinese farmers know very little about genetics. They don’t know how to get the right information. Dutch pig farmers help them. Difficult words: produce (to make something), feed (food for animals), genetics (science which changes information in a plant or animal to make a different plant or animal). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A teenage gunman opened fire at an elementary school in Texas, US, killing 19 children and two adults. The suspect was identified as 18-year-old Salvador Ramos, and according to police, he acted alone. Ramos armed himself with rifles that he purchased on his birthday, and before heading to the school, he shot his grandmother. However, the woman survived her wounds, and she called the police. Meanwhile, Ramos fled the house, crashed his car near the school, and then entered through a back door. The shooter was a high school dropout and had no criminal record. He died at the scene, reportedly by police. Children aged 7 to 11 were at the school, and the event was the deadliest school shooting in the US in the last decade. It was also the 27 th school shooting in the country this year. The White House lowered its flag to honor the victims; the US president said that the government needed was to stand up to the gun lobby . Difficult words: dropout (a student who leaves school before finishing it), honor (to show great respect for someone in public), lobby (an organized group of people who influence lawmakers on a particular issue). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last week, 18-year-old Salvador Ramos killed 19 children and two adults at an elementary school in Texas, US. Ramos lived with his grandmother, and he wrote on social media that he would kill her. He shot her in the face, got in a car, and drove to the school. He crashed the car nearby. His grandmother survived the attack, and she called the police. Meanwhile, Ramos entered the school through a back door, and he started shooting. He had guns which he bought on his birthday. Reports said that police killed him at the scene . The Texas shooting was the worst school shooting in the US in the last ten years, and it was the 27 th school shooting this year. The US president said that the government must stop the gun lobby . Children are now scared to go to school, and parents are worried if they would see their children after school. Difficult words: survive (to be alive after something bad happens), scene (the place where something happens), lobby (a group of people who want to make politicians change the law because it will help them). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Salvador Ramos is 18 years old. He lives with his grandmother in Texas, US. He buys guns on his birthday. He writes on social media that he will shoot his grandmother. Then he shoots her in her face. Then he gets in a car. He drives to an elementary school . He gets inside through a back door. He kills 19 children and two adults . Later police shoot him. The event is the worst school shooting in the US in the last 10 years. It is the 27 th school shooting this year. Parents are scared to send their children to school. Children are scared to go to school. The US president says that the gun lobby must stop. Difficult words: elementary school (a school for children between five and eleven years old), adult (a person who is older than a child), lobby (a group of people who talk to politicians, and they want them to change laws). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Japanese researchers and the French National Center for Scientific Research co-developed a robotic sixth finger. You wear the finger next to the pinkie , and the aim is to study the brain’s reaction to new and independent body parts. Scientists already know that we move our own body with our brain, and now, they want to find out if our brain can adapt to a new body part. The research started because they were interested to study if the brain will accept the sixth finger or not use the finger for convenience . Sensors measure electrical signals from muscles, and they then transfer them to a motor to control the robotic finger. Researchers say that the sixth finger can enhance daily human activities such as typing and carrying more objects. Scientists say that if this technology develops, one day, people may be able to freely design their bodies. An example is glasses that are an accessory and functional, too. Difficult words: pinkie (the smallest finger on the hand), convenience (useful, helpful, or easy to use), enhance (to improve the quality or value of something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Japanese and French scientists developed a robotic sixth finger. Scientists wanted to see what would happen from the sixth finger. They attached it to the hand next to the smallest finger, and they studied how the brain reacted. They already knew that we move the body with our brain. Special sensors measure signals from muscles, and they then control the robotic finger. Scientists believe that we will change our bodies freely in the future. They say that the sixth finger is something like glasses. People wear them as an accessory , but they make their life easier. People will use the sixth finger to be able to carry more things or to type. Difficult words: robotic (something that looks or address like a human, but it is a machine), sensor (a device to check and react to things like movement, heat, or light), accessory (a thing to make something better or more useful). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Japanese and French scientists make a sixth finger. It is a robotic finger. Robotic means that it is a machine. Scientists know that we move our body with the brain. They want to see what happens to the brain when something is new on the body. Scientists attach the sixth finger to a hand. It is next to the smallest finger. A sensor checks how the muscles on the arm move. A special device then moves the sixth finger. Scientists say that the sixth finger can be very useful. For example, it helps you to type or carry many things in one hand. In the future, people may wear it just like they wear glasses today. Difficult words: sensor (a device to check something), muscle (a soft part of the body which makes it possible to move), type (to write on a computer). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A man was crossing the street in eastern China when two cars entered the crossroads from different sides. They swerved to avoid a collision but bumped into each other instead, as they sped towards the unsuspecting pedestrian. Luckily, he was able to react quickly and leapt out of harm’s way, escaping death. While both vehicles had heavy damage, no one was injured. Difficult words: swerve (suddenly change direction), unsuspecting (not knowing about the present danger), leap (move quickly and suddenly). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A man was crossing a busy highway in China when two vehicles entered the crossroads from different sides. The car and the truck tried to avoid an accident, but they hit each other and almost hit the man. The man was extremely lucky. The two vehicles hit just inches from him. He was almost crushed. Nobody was injured but the accident heavily damaged both vehicles. Difficult words: vehicle (something used for transportation), crossroads (a place where two roads meet and cross each other), avoid (when don’t want something to happen and you try to stop it). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This news is from China. A man is on a highway. He wants to cross it. This is dangerous. Two cars come. They might hit each other. They try to avoid an accident, but they hit each other. They hit only inches from the man. The man is really lucky. He jumps away, and the cars don’t hit him. He is fine. Difficult words: cross (get on the other side), might (can), avoid (when don’t want something to happen and you try to stop it). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Algerian restaurant owner Amer Halimi is proud of his specialty , a traditional dish of meat that’s slowly cooked underground. The dish is called ‘Merdouma’ which means ‘buried’ in Arabic. Halimi buries the meat with stones heated by charcoal , and when the charcoal goes off, he cooks the meat for nearly 14 hours. Then, he serves it with a special sauce that makes the meat crunchy from the outside and juicy from the inside. Customers come from everywhere in the country to try the delicious dish. According to Halimi, the dish is very old, and people used to cook it on stones. Over time, it developed, and he took the idea even further. He put a well inside in his restaurant. Difficult words: specialty (a product, usually food, which a person or region is famous for), charcoal (a black material similar to coal), well (a deep hole in the ground with water). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In the past, people in Algeria cooked meat on stones. The method slowly changed, and a restaurant owner named Amer Halimi came up with something very special. Halimi has a hole in the ground inside his restaurant. He puts charcoal in the hole, and he lights it. When the charcoal goes off , he puts the meat in the hole. Then he cooks the meat for 13 to 14 hours. He serves the dish with a special sauce which makes the meat crunchy but juicy at the same time. Halimi is proud of his dish, and people from all over the country come to his restaurant to taste it. Difficult words: charcoal (a black material which looks similar to coal), go off (to stop light or heat), proud (a feeling of happiness from something that you did or that you have). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Amer Halimi owns a restaurant in Algeria. People from all over the country come to his restaurant. They want to taste his special dish. Halimi cooks meat. The way he cooks is very special. He makes a hole in the ground in his restaurant. He puts charcoal there. When the hole is hot enough, he puts meat there. He cooks the meat for 13 to 14 hours. He serves the meat with a special sauce. This sauce makes the meat crunchy and juicy . In the past, people cook meat on hot stones. This way slowly changes. Halimi thinks of the best ways to cook meat. Guests in his restaurant love the meat. Difficult words: charcoal (a light black thing which burns easily), serve (to give food), crunchy and juicy (a food that makes sharp noises when you eat it and not dry). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

McDonald’s first restaurant in Russia opened in the Middle of Moscow more than three decades ago, shortly after the fall of the Berlin Wall. It was a powerful symbol of easing Cold War tensions between the US and Soviet Union, which collapsed in 1991. Last week, the McDonald’s symbol, a logo in the form of two golden arches, was taken down at a restaurant near Moscow after the multinational burger chain sold its stores, and said that it would leave Russia. The company temporarily closed hundreds of locations in March, after Russia invaded Ukraine in February. The decision has cost McDonald’s about $55 million per month, and the company decided to sell all its sites to a local buyer. The company said that one of its priorities was to ensure that its 62,000 employees in Russia would get paid until the sale was completed and they had future employment with any potential buyer. Alexander Gavor, and existing McDonald’s licensee , operates 25 restaurants in Siberia, and he has bought McDonald’s 850 Russian restaurants. He agreed to operate them under a new name. Difficult words: temporarily (for a limited period of time), potential (possible), licensee (a person or organization that has official permission to do or own something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

American multinational fast food chain decided to leave Russia after more than 30 years. In February, Russia attacked Ukraine, and as a result, McDonald’s closed its 850 restaurants in Russia. This cost the company $55 million every month. Now, the company decided to sell its restaurants to Alexander Gavor. Gavor owns a McDonald’s license , and he runs 25 restaurants in Siberia. He agreed to run the restaurants under a different name. 62,000 people worked in all the McDonald’s restaurants in Russia, and the company said that they would get their wages until there was a new buyer. On Monday, workers took down the typical McDonald’s logo, two golden arches. It happened at a restaurant near Moscow, and it will happen in all the other restaurants, too. Difficult words: multinational (a very large company, which has offices or stores in many different countries), license (an official document, which says that someone can do something), wages (money, which a person gets for his work). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

McDonald’s is a fast food company. It has restaurants in all world. It has 850 restaurants in Russia. In March, McDonald’s closes its restaurants in Russia. The company thinks that it will be only for some time. But it costs $55 million every month. 62,000 people work for McDonald’s in Russia. The company decides to sell all its restaurants in Russia. A man buys the restaurants. He already runs some restaurants in Siberia. The man will change the name of the restaurant. On Mondays, workers take down the first logo at a restaurant near Moscow. The logo is two golden arches . Difficult words: fast food (meal which people can eat quickly, such as pizza or burgers), logo (a picture of symbol, which represents something), arch (a curved structure, which holds up a bridge or wall). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A small Finnish brewery is only a few kilometers from the Russian border. It has launched a NATO-themed beer to celebrate the Nordic country’s NATO application. Olaf Brewing’s OTAN lager features a blue label with a cartoon version of a medieval knight in metal armor, emblazoned with NATO’s compass symbol. The beer’s name is a joke on the Finnish expression ‘Otan olutta’, that means ‘I’ll have a beer’, and the French abbreviation of NATO, which is ‘OTAN’. The CEO of the family-run brewery said that the brew had a taste of security with a hint of freedom. Last week, Finland and Sweden applied to join the Western military alliance, a decision spurred by their concern over the Russian invasion of Ukraine. Difficult words: emblazon (to decorate), hint (a small amount of something), spur (to encourage an activity to happen faster). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A small Finnish brewery made a beer to celebrate the country’s application to join NATO. The family brewery is only a few kilometers from the Russian border, and its CEO said that the beer tasted of safety and freedom. The beer comes in blue and white cans, which match NATO’s colors. The cans show a knight who holds a beer, and he has NATO’s logo on his armor . The beer is called Otan Olutta, and it is a joke with words. OTAN is the French name of NATO, and the full name of the beer means ‘I’ll have some beer’ in Finnish. Last week, Finland and Sweden decided to work to join NATO. Both countries decided to do it after Russia attacked Finland’s neighbor Ukraine in February. Difficult words: application (a formal request to join an organization), knight (a man from the Middle Ages who fought on horseback), armor (pieces of metal that protect the body in a fight). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A small Finnish brewery makes a special beer. The brewery is only a few kilometers from Russia. The name of the beer is Otan Olutta. The name means ‘I’ll have some beer’ in Finnish. OTAN is also the French word for NATO. Last week, Finland and Sweden decide to join NATO. They are afraid of Russia. The beer celebrates NATO. The boss of the brewery says that the beer tastes of safety and freedom . The can is blue and white. They are the colors of NATO. A knight is on the can. He is drinking a beer. He has a symbol of NATO on his body. Difficult words: brewery (a place that makes beer), freedom (the situation to be free to live how you want), knight (a man from the past, who fights on a horse). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Mount Etna is Europe’s tallest and one of the world’s most active volcanoes. The volcano is on the east coast of Sicily, Italy, near the city of Catania. Mount Etna has almost constant activity, which alternates periods of rest and periods of eruption. The volcano has one of the world’s longest documented history of activity over 3,500 years. Over a six-month period in 2021, Etna erupted so much volcanic material that its height increased 30 meters. In March 2021, it erupted 11 times in three weeks. The eruptions consistently sent ash clouds over 10 kilometers into the air, and the clouds closed Sicilian airports. Last week, Mount Etna erupted again with plumes of ash in the sky, and it disrupted flights. People watched a stunning display of lava flowing down the mountain and heading for the ‘Lion Valley’. Difficult words: alternate (to happen repeatedly), consistently (in a way that doesn’t change), plume (a large quantity of something that rises into the air). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Mount Etna is the tallest volcano in Europe. It is also one of the world’s most active volcanoes because it is active almost all the time. Mount Etna is in Sicily, an Italian island. It is near the city of Catania, which it threatened many times in the past. People wrote about the volcano more than 3,500 years ago. In 2021, Etna was very active. It erupted so much material that it grew 30 meters higher. In March 2021, it erupted 11 times in three weeks. The ash cloud was as high as 10 kilometers, and planes couldn’t fly. Last week, Mount Etna erupted again. People saw lava , which looked like an orange river, and it moved down the mountain. Once again, some flights were canceled. Difficult words: threaten (to put someone or something at risk), ash (a grey powder after something burns), lava (hot liquid rock which comes out of a volcano). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Mount Etna is a volcano in Sicily, Italy. It is the tallest volcano in Europe. It is 3,357 meters tall. Mount Etna is very active . It is active almost all the time. Only sometimes, the volcano stops. Mount Etna is near the city of Catania. The volcano is very dangerous in the past. People write about it 3,500 years ago. It erupts a lot. To erupt means that lava and smoke come out of it. Etna is very active in 2021. It erupts 11 times in three weeks. The volcano gets 30 meters higher. Last week, it erupts again. People can see an orange river of lava at night. Planes can’t fly. Difficult words: volcano (a mountain which has hot rocks inside it), active (events that happen a lot), lava (a hot orange rock, which looks like a river). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The monkeypox outbreak is raising alarm in Europe and the US. Monkeypox is a virus that causes a fever and a distinctive bumpy rash. The two main strains are the Congo strain and the west African strain. The Congo strain is more severe with up to 10% mortality while the west African strain has mortality of 1%. The disease spreads through close contact, and it mostly occurs in west and central Africa. It occasionally spreads elsewhere; however, infections have been confirmed in nine European countries, as well as the US, Canada, and Australia. The virus doesn’t spread easily between people, and experts say that the risk is low to the wider public. However, this time, the spread is puzzling experts because a number of cases in the UK have no known connections. The UK and US health officials also highlighted that the recent cases were predominantly men who self-identified as gay or bisexual. No specific vaccine exists for monkeypox; however, a smallpox vaccine offers 85% protection because of virus similarities. Difficult words: strain (a natural type of a bacteria, virus, or small living thing), mortality (a loss of life), predominantly (mainly). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Monkeypox is a virus, which causes fever and a rash . It is usual in west and central Africa, and it rarely spreads elsewhere. Monkeypox has two main strains called the west African and the Congo strains. The Congo strain is more dangerous, and about 10% of patients die from it. Now, nine European countries, the US, Canada, and Australia confirmed monkeypox infections, which worries officials. Experts don’t know how the virus spreads, but many cases were among gay or bisexual men. We have no vaccine for monkeypox, but we can use a vaccine for smallpox , which is quite similar. The vaccine protects about 85% of people. Difficult words: rash (red and itchy skin), confirm (to say that something is true), smallpox (a disease, which causes fever, spots on the skin, and often death). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Monkeypox is a disease. It gives people a fever and a rash. The sick person gets red bumps on the skin. Monkeypox usually happens in Africa. It rarely moves to other countries. Now, it is in nine countries in Europe, the US, Canada, and Australia. Experts don’t know how the virus leaves Africa. Many patients are men. They are gay or bisexual . Experts say that monkeypox isn’t very dangerous. Smallpox is a similar disease. It is more dangerous. We have a vaccine for it. The vaccine keeps most people safe from smallpox. Difficult words: rarely (not very often), bisexual (when someone likes both men and women sexually), vaccine (a medicine to stop a disease before it makes you sick). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Last week, Joe and Jess Thwaite from Gloucester won a 230-million-dollar jackpot on EuroMillions. It became the UK’s biggest lottery haul and made the couple richer than singer Adele. The couple said they initially thought the win was a mistake. They said that the win would give them time to share experiences and go on adventures with their family and friends. Mrs. Thwaite runs a hairdressing salon with her sister; however, she’s going to reconsider her role there. Mr. Thwaite confirmed he’d already left his job as a communications sales manager. The couple have two children, and they’d always talked about going to Hawaii. The win will give them time to dream. Difficult words: jackpot (a large cash prize in a game or lottery), haul (a large amount), initially (at first). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Last week, a couple from Gloucester, UK, won $230 million in a lottery . It was the highest win in history; the previous record of $212 million was in October 2019. Joe Thwaite learned in the morning that he won, and he waited for his wife Jess to wake up. When he told her about the win, she thought that it was a mistake. She couldn’t believe it at all. Joe already quit his job, but his wife doesn’t know what to do. She runs a hairdressing salon with her sister, and she must decide if she will continue. The couple have two children, and they always wanted to go to Hawaii. With all that money, it’ll be possible to make the dream come true. The couple want to travel the world to visit family and friends. They couldn’t easily visit them if they didn’t have the money. Difficult words: lottery (a game to bet on numbers, and winners get prizes if these numbers are chosen), record (the best, highest, or fastest thing), quit (to stop doing something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Joe and Tess Thwaite come from Gloucester, UK. Last week, they win $230 million in a lottery . It is the highest win in history. Joe wakes up early in the morning. He gets a message that he wins. He is thinking about buying a bigger house. He is waiting for his wife to wake up. When Tess wakes up, Joe tells her about the win. She doesn’t believe it. She thinks that it is a mistake . Joe stops his work. Tess has a hairdressing salon with her sister. She must think about what to do. The couple have two children. They want to travel. They will visit their family and friends in different countries. Difficult words: lottery (when a person chooses some numbers on a ticket, and if these numbers win, the person gets money), mistake (a wrong or incorrect action), hairdressing salon (a place where a hairdresser cuts people’s hair). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Google showed its plans for the future of work at its new campus in Silicon Valley, California. The 93,000-square-meter campus features two office buildings and one event building, and around 40,000 employees will work there. The campus and its three buildings are Google’s first buildings from the ground up . They are going to provide new hybrid ways of working, that would require employees to work in the offices a few times a week. The company wanted to rethink the nature of a workplace and how it can make buildings and structures that people will love and use for decades. According to Google, sustainability is key to the campus. 90,000 silver solar panels on the roof generate up to 40% of the offices’ energy needs. Automated window shades let in natural lighting, and a ventilation system uses 100% outside air. Difficult words: from the ground up (from the beginning), hybrid (a combination of two different things), sustainability (the production of things without damage to the environment). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Google built its newest campus in Silicon Valley, California. The campus has three buildings with a total area of 93,000 square meters. It has two office buildings and one event building. Google wanted to create a completely new workplace which its employees would really love. Around 40,000 employees will work at the campus, and Google’s idea is they will work in the offices on some days of the week. 90,000 silver solar panels are on the roof, and they look like dragon scales . They can make 40% of the energy for the buildings. They have daylight inside, and employees get fresh air from the outside. Difficult words: campus (the buildings of a college, university, or a large organization), workplace (a building or room where people work), scale (a part of the skin of fish, snakes, lizards, and so on). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Google builds a new campus . It is in Silicon Valley, California. The campus has three buildings. Two buildings are for offices. One building is for special events . The campus has 93,000 square meters. Around 40,000 employees will work there. Google wants to make a place which its employees will love. The campus looks very different from other offices. The city of Pontevedra in the northwest of Spain has been transformed over the past 20 years by policies prioritising pedestrians over cars. Miguel Anxo Fernández, the mayor of Pontevedra, said that people changed the paradigm – giving 70 per cent of public space to the people and 27–30 per cent to the cars. City streets have radically changed and there have been zero fatal road accidents since 2011 as well as a 67 per cent drop in CO2 emissions since the 1990s. Most cars are banned from the medieval city centre and 73 per cent of journeys in the city are made on foot or by bike. Difficult words: pedestrian (a person who is walking), paradigm (a typical model of how something is done), fatal (deadly). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Since Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, Finland and Sweden have strongly considered applying for NATO membership. In the Czech Republic, the world’s longest pedestrian suspension bridge opened at a mountain resort. The 721-meter-long bridge is at an altitude of more than 1,100 meters above sea level, and it connects two ridges of the mountains. Critics say that the structure is too big for the area, and it’ll bring too many tourists to the town which has a population of less than 500 people. Authorities believe that the bridge will attract tourists from all around the globe. Difficult words: suspension bridge (a bridge with strong steel ropes and towers), ridge (the line top of a mountain), have a head for (to understand something or to handle it).
